name: MCP server
description: `afterglow mcp`: a Model Context Protocol server over stdio that serves every app's command catalog as tools. MCPVersions pins the protocol revisions (2026-07-28 sessionless; 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 start with initialize); JSONRPC frames one JSON-RPC 2.0 message per line; MCPServer (with MCPOptions: apps, roots, limits) answers each line; MCPTools lists the tools and routes a tool name to an MCPRoute; MCPSessions holds the open documents by expiring handle and returns MCPToolResults. MC-4 builds the server: strict JSON-RPC parsing (-32700, -32600), version negotiation (-32602 listing supportedVersions), server/discover, initialize, ping, tools/list, rate-limited tools/call, silent notifications, and serve (`--app`, `--root`, `--live`) reading stdin line by line. MC-6 builds the tools: each app's open and new, then afterglow.save, export and close, then every command as <app>.<id> in id order with input {doc, params} and annotations from its kind; MC-8 fills the calls.
